([[Tempe, Arizona]]) | college = [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]] (2017–2020) | highlights = * Second-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] ([[2019–20 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|2020]]) }} '''Saben Lee''' (born June 23, 1999) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores]]. ==Early life and high school career== Lee grew up in [[Phoenix, Arizona]] and attended [[Corona del Sol High School]] in [[Tempe, Arizona]]. He played on the freshman team and was a backup on the varsity team as a sophomore. As a junior, Lee was named first-team All-State after averaging 18 points, five rebounds, and three assists per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.azdesertswarm.com/recruiting/2016/6/1/11816360/arizona-basketball-recruiting-in-state-prospect-saben-lees-recruitment-heating-up|title=Arizona basketball recruiting: In-state prospect Saben Lee's recruitment heating up|first=Alec|last=Sills-Trausch|website=AZDesertSwarm.com|date=June 1, 2016}} Lee committed to play college basketball at Vanderbilt after his junior year over offers from Louisville, Stanford, Florida State, and Nebraska.{{cite web|url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/high-school/recruiting/2016/06/14/corona-del-sol-pg-saben-lee-commits-vanderbilt/85867166/|title=Corona Del Sol PG Saben Lee commits to Vanderbilt|work=[[The Arizona Republic]]}}{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2646167-saben-lee-to-vanderbilt-commodores-land-4-star-pg-prospect|title=Saben Lee to Vanderbilt: Commodores Land 4-Star PG Prospect|first=Danny|last=Webster|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|date=June 14, 2016}} He was again named first team All-State as a senior and scored 39 points against [[Cesar Chavez High School (Phoenix, Arizona)|Cesar Chavez High School]] in the state semifinal to lead the Aztecs to the state title game before falling to [[Basha High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.prephoops.com/2017/03/arizona-6a-state/|title=Arizona 6A All-State|first=Jordan|last=Augustine|website=PrepHoops.com|date=October 22, 2017}}{{cite web|url=https://usatodayhss.com/2017/corona-del-sol-returns-to-final-behind-saben-lees-39-points-will-meet-basha-for-6a-boys-crown|title=Corona del Sol returns to final behind Saben Lee's 39 points, will meet Basha for 6A boys crown|first=Richard|last=Obert|website=USATodayHSS.com|date=February 24, 2017}} ==College career== Lee served as the Commodores starting point guard as a true freshman and averaged 10.6 points, 3.1 assists and a team-leading 1.2 steals per game.{{cite web|url=https://sports.usatoday.com/2018/10/03/vanderbilt-basketballs-darius-garland-saben-lee-working-on-chemistry/|title=Vanderbilt basketball's Darius Garland, Saben Lee working on chemistry|first=Adam|last=Sparks|website=[[USAToday.com]]|publisher=[[Nashville Tennessean]]|date=October 3, 2018}} As a sophomore, Lee averaged 12.7 points, 3.3 rebounds, 3.8 assists and 1.0 steals per game.{{cite web|url=http://www.tnledger.com/editorial/article.aspx?id=115302|title=Vanderbilt’s Lee making the most of challenging season|first=Ivan|last=Aronin|work=The Nashville Ledger|date=March 8, 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/vanderbilt/basketball/stackhouse-commodores-kickoff-regular-season-wednesday|title=Stackhouse, Commodores Kickoff Regular Season Wednesday|first=Greg|last=Arias|website=[[Sports Illustrated|SI.com]]|date=November 5, 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://bustingbrackets.com/2019/09/01/sec-basketball-top-returning-players-team-2019-20-season/2/|title=SEC Basketball: Top returning players on each team for 2019-20 season|first=Charlie|last=DiSturco|website=BustingBrackets.com|publisher=[[FanSided]]}} As a junior, he averaged 18.6 points, 3.5 rebounds, 4.2 assists and 1.5 steals per game and was named second team All-SEC by the [[Associated Press]].{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2880701-sec-2020-final-team-standings-top-player-stats-and-best-nba-draft-prospects|title=SEC 2020 Final Team Standings, Top Player Stats and Best NBA Draft Prospects|first=Joe|last=Tansey|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|date=March 13, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/vanderbilt/basketball/vanderbilts-saben-lee-scottie-pippen-jr-honored-by-sec|title=Vanderbilt's Saben Lee, Scottie Pippen Jr. Honored By SEC|first=Greg|last=Arias|website=[[Sports Illustrated|SI.com]]|date=March 9, 2020}} He scored a career high 38 points on March 3, 2020 in an 87–79 win over [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401166380|title=Lee's 38 leads Vanderbilt to 87-79 upset of Alabama|website=[[ESPN.com]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=March 3, 2020}} Following the end of the season, Lee declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/vanderbilt/2020/03/27/saben-lee-declares-nba-draft-vanderbilt-basketball/2926329001/|title=Vanderbilt guard Saben Lee declares for NBA Draft|work=[[The Tennessean]]|date=March 27, 2020|access-date=March 28, 2020}} On May 1, he announced he was signing with an agent and forgoing his last season of eligibility.{{cite news |last1=Weinstein |first1=Robbie |title=Vanderbilt's Saben Lee signs with agent, will stay in NBA Draft |url=https://247sports.com/college/vanderbilt/Article/Vanderbilt-Commodores-Saben-Lee-signs-with-agent-will-stay-in-NBA-Draft-146718540/ |accessdate=May 3, 2020 |work=247 Sports |date=May 1, 2020}}
